Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items

Tom — thanks, appreciate the clear ask. Below is the handoff checklist and what we need from your side to get the POC environment live: 

POC handoff checklist (high level):
- Org & billing: create your Redwoods-org alias (we'll provision a sandbox org under the MAP)
- Service accounts: we will generate two short-lived API keys (test and smoke) scoped to the sandbox org
- IP allowlist: please provide the NAT public IPs or CIDR blocks you can open; we'll add them to the per-org allowlist
- VPC peering: we can do either managed peering (preferred) or customer-initiated peering. For managed peering we need: your VPC ID, cloud region, and account/project id. For customer-initiated, we'll provide a peering config and a tunnel endpoint.
- KMS/TLS: confirm whether you need keys in your KMS or if Redwood-managed TLS is acceptable for the eval.

Suggested timeline:
- Day 0 (handoff): exchange org IDs, network contacts, and CIDRs
- Day 1: Redwood config complete (allowlist + sandbox org + test keys)
- Day 2: VPC peering validation and small-scale smoke tests
- Day 3–4: Full ramp/smoke with 3-GPU burst (if agreed)

Items we need from Acme today to start:
1) Network contact + email (ops@acmehealth.com looks good)
2) Public NAT IPs or CIDR ranges to add to allowlist
3) Choice on peering mode (managed vs customer-initiated)
4) Any compliance constraint on key custody (KMS)

I've attached a working MAP sheet and a simple VPC sketch to this thread. Once we get the CIDRs and peering preference I'll open the config ticket and create the two test keys.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP_AcmeHealth_v1.xlsx; Attachment: vpc-peering-sketch.png)
